Package dev.px.core.render.theme

Class Theme

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.render.theme.Theme
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named
public final class Theme extends Object implements Named
A named colour scheme.

Generalises the old AccentColor, which held two colours and left every call site to decide what a background, an outline, or muted text should be. Those are derived here, so a new theme is two colours and the whole GUI follows, and a client that wants full control can override the derived roles.

    • animatedAccent

      public Color animatedAccent(float cyclesPerSecond, float offset)
      The accent at a point in a continuously cycling gradient.

      Ping-pongs rather than wrapping, so the colour never jumps back to the start. Used for animated element backgrounds.

      Parameters:
      cyclesPerSecond - full sweeps per second
      offset - phase shift, so adjacent elements are not all the same colour
